STATE.PRIMITIVE_SOURCE_MODEL_QUALIFICATION: Static callsites preserve the accepted source-only primitive semantics; no complete wrapper-boundary or privileged-database-path linkage is established.

METHOD.SCOPE: Preserved source-only registry of callable authentication, organization, role/admin, RLS-context, and entitlement primitives from the accepted Phase 1B.2a boundary evidence.
METHOD.SOURCE_READ_POLICY: This normalization does not reopen application source or derive new call references. It retains the frozen primitive array and verifies its pre-normalization SHA-256 digest.
METHOD.CLASSIFICATION_POLICY: Descriptions record observed implementation behavior and failure/fallback paths. They do not certify correctness, effective authorization, runtime reachability, or security sufficiency.
LIMITATIONS: The accepted census has an empty WRAPPER_BOUNDARY_GRAPH and no recorded PRIVILEGED_DATABASE_PATHS. This registry therefore cannot claim complete wrapper composition or privileged-database-path coverage.
Import paths, source declarations, and static call sites do not prove runtime reachability or successful enforcement.
No resource-permission callable or independently verified privileged-database path is established by this extracted denominator; do not interpret that as absence in runtime.
The source ranges establish only direct calls to the listed helpers; hidden indirection, dynamic behavior, external middleware, database policies, and runtime identity remain outside this registry.
Census signal names not represented as source-resolved callable primitives are preserved below as excluded signals, not silently treated as enforced controls.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: Identity resolution entry point; internal provider order is acceptance, PG session, then Entra/NextAuth.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Resolves the active identity from the accepted staging-acceptance path, optional PG-session path, then the Entra/NextAuth path; returns user, organization, role, provider, and session metadata.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Optional-provider errors are caught so resolution can continue; the function can return an unauthenticated result when no provider resolves. Runtime identity was not exercised.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: Provider order is the fallback chain. The acceptance path is documented as identity-only; downstream authorization remains separate.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: Profile lookup; not by itself an organization-membership or authorization check.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Returns the current provider user profile where available; used alongside auth() when profile or metadata fields are needed.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Provider failures may be caught by the caller; this source pass does not establish runtime identity availability.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: Caller-specific fallback behavior is recorded in the calling primitive when applicable.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: App-level identity resolution entry point, separate from role authorization.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Resolves a Union Eyes AuthUser from PG session auth first, then the platform provider path, and supplements the result with application role and organization data.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: The PG lookup path can fall through; membership lookup failure can preserve a default member role. A nullable result is possible.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: PG session authentication precedes the platform authentication path; role lookup can fall back to member.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: Organization resolution; it does not by itself establish that a requested resource belongs to that organization.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Resolves an application organization identifier for a user through the organization utility path.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Callers may catch lookup errors and retain auth metadata or return an error; no runtime membership result was checked.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: Several callers retain provider metadata organization context when lookup fails; behavior is caller-specific.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: Identity → organization lookup → canonical role lookup → hierarchy comparison.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Resolves the user and application organization, then compares the database role level with the requested minimum role.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Catches errors and returns false, including unresolved identity, organization, and role lookup failures.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: No access-granting fallback is present in the inspected function; errors resolve to false.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: Identity → system-admin flag query.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Checks the system-administrator flag for an explicit or authenticated user ID.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Logs exceptions and returns false.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: No positive fallback is present in the inspected helper.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: System-admin check → throw on false.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Calls isSystemAdmin and throws when the check is false.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Throws a system-administrator-required error on denial; downstream HTTP mapping is caller-specific.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: None observed.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: Identity → user-context lookup → return or throw.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Requires an authenticated user and a resolved application user context.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Throws Unauthorized when auth has no user ID and Forbidden when the application user context cannot be resolved.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: None observed.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: User ID → organization-specific context lookup → return or throw.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Requires an authenticated or explicitly supplied user ID and a user context for the specified organization.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Throws Unauthorized when no user ID exists and Forbidden when organization-specific user context is unresolved.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: An explicitly supplied user ID takes precedence over resolving the ID again from auth().

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: Identity → role resolution → return or throw.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Requires a current authenticated user and returns the user ID with the resolved application role.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Throws when identity or role resolution is unavailable; exact caller error mapping varies.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: Role resolution follows the rbac-server path; no runtime role was tested.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: requireAuth → administrative-role condition.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Requires an authenticated user and applies the rbac-server administrative-role condition.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Throws when the user is missing or the administrative condition is not met.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: None observed.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: Route classification → cron check or user auth → handler.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Wraps an API handler with route/public/cron classification and optional auth requirement.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Returns 401 for failed cron authentication, missing identity, or auth exceptions.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: Public routes and routes configured with requireAuth=false proceed without user authentication; cron routes use cron-secret verification.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: withApiAuth → identity → organization → exact-role check → handler → asynchronous audit for selected role tiers.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Deprecated wrapper that authenticates, resolves organization context, checks an exact role, and then invokes the handler.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Authentication failures return 401; role denial returns 403. Organization lookup failure can fall back to provider metadata.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: Organization lookup errors retain user.organizationId; the role check uses the helper’s application role path.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: Organization authentication → membership lookup → role/super-admin check → handler.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Wraps organization authentication, loads organization membership, checks the configured role hierarchy, and invokes the handler.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Missing membership or insufficient role returns 403; unexpected failures inside this role wrapper return 500.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: If the user is not in the active organization, a configured super-admin organization membership may allow admin/super_admin access.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: withApiAuth → identity → organization → minimum-role check → handler → asynchronous audit for selected role tiers.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Deprecated minimum-role wrapper that authenticates, resolves organization context, checks role hierarchy, and then invokes the handler.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: No user or failed minimum-role check returns an authorization response; role-check exceptions in hasMinRole return false.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: Organization lookup errors can retain auth metadata organization; access is not granted by that fallback alone.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: requireUser → system-sentinel RLS org resolution → org-scoped RLS → membership check → handler.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Requires a user, resolves organization under an authenticated system-sentinel RLS context, then checks organization membership and runs the handler in organization RLS context.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Maps Unauthorized to 401, Forbidden to 403, and logs/maps unexpected errors to 500.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: No organization-metadata fallback is present in the inspected wrapper.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: Validate supplied context → auth → resolve/enforce organization (or system sentinel) → transaction-local context → callback.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Runs an operation in a transaction with authenticated user context and transaction-local PostgreSQL RLS settings; an explicit context map requires a non-empty organizationId.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Throws when user identity is absent, when explicit organization context is invalid, or when default organization resolution is absent.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: Default org resolution tries provider org metadata and then currentUser metadata; lookup exceptions do not bypass the missing-org failure.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: System-role transaction → clear local user/org variables → bind system transaction → callback.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Runs work on systemDb in a transaction associated with the union_eyes_system database role, clears context variables, and scopes module-level db access to the transaction.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Database transaction or callback errors propagate from the inspected implementation.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: No tenant-connection fallback is described; system authority depends on the explicitly named database role policies.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: Organization lookup → tier feature decision → optional credit check.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Checks an organization subscription tier and feature list, and checks available credits for credit-requiring features.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Unknown organization and disallowed feature return denied results; caught failures are logged and return a denied result.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: Missing/unknown subscription tier defaults to free.

PRIMITIVES.INVOCATION_ORDER: Module entitlement check → failure audit and throw on denial → return on allowance.
PRIMITIVES.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: Checks a module entitlement for an organization and returns the entitlement result only when allowed.
PRIMITIVES.FAILURE_SEMANTICS: Denied results are audited and then raised as EntitlementError; audit failures are not converted to a successful entitlement.
PRIMITIVES.CAUGHT_OR_FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR: None observed.
